title: Complete quantum channel information order is coRE-complete for rational positive POVMs

scoped_dependencies.relation: Context-only relation within complete-information-order research. The source-reported finite sufficient lift certificate in N661 is not a general decision algorithm; this unreviewed generic-class undecidability claim neither validates nor refutes N661.

interface: For each finite test, dimensions may grow with the instance; the classified inputs are rational-complex strictly positive POVM pairs on a common input.
failure: The source claims that no total computable function of the rational POVM pair bounds a reference dimension sufficient to witness every complete-SLD failure.
